The Corporation has its main business&nbsp;in gathering, importing, transporting, storing, processing and trading gas and gas products. GAS&nbsp;is the only company that has full gas infrastructure including gas gathering systems at sources, pipeline for transportation and distribution, storage system, and gas processing plant with 3 gas pipeline systems: Cuu Long, Nam Con Son in the Southeast region, PM3 in the Southwest region and two gas processing plants: Dinh Co, Nam Con Son in the Southeast region and an LPG storage system nationwide. GAS&nbsp;has a total capacity of 450,000 - 500,000 tons&nbsp;of&nbsp;LPG per year and&nbsp;70,000 tons of condensate per year. The Corporation maintains its leading position in LPG supply with more than 70% of the LPG market share in Vietnam. GAS&nbsp;has been listed on Hochiminh Stock Exchange (HOSE) since 2012.</p>\r\n</div> <div style="FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt;">\r\n<p class="MsoNormal">Tổng C&ocirc;ng ty Kh&iacute; Việt Nam-CTCP (GAS) c&oacute; tiền th&acirc;n l&agrave; C&ocirc;ng ty Kh&iacute; đốt được th&agrave;nh lập&nbsp;v&agrave;o năm 1990, l&agrave; đơn vị th&agrave;nh vi&ecirc;n thuộc Tập Đo&agrave;n Dầu Kh&iacute; Quốc gia Việt Nam. Starting from a company specializing in trading construction machines since August 1992, currently, Hoa Phat Group operates mainly in the fields of iron and steel, steel products, household electrical appliances, agriculture, and real estate. In which, Steel field plays a key role and is the core business of the group contributing more than 90% of revenue and profit. HPG is currently the largest steel producer in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, with a crude steel capacity of 8.5 million tons per year. In 2024, the company continued to strengthen its number-one market share in long steel at 38%, and remains the only Vietnamese enterprise capable of producing hot rolled coil (HRC). It has completed a merger with VPSC (one subsidiary of VNPT), to be renamed Lien Viet Post Bank.&nbsp;The bank has partnerships with both national and international groups such as (i) National groups: Viettel, EVN, (ii) La Poste Group, The World Savings Bank Institute, US Trade and Development Agency (USTDA), JP Morgan Chase, Wells Fargo and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC). PNJ has its business in the fabrication and trade&nbsp;of&nbsp;gold, silver, and gemstone jewelry. The Company&nbsp;has been put into operation under the model of a joint stock company since&nbsp;2004.&nbsp;PNJ currently manages and operates 2 factories with a total production capacity of over 5&nbsp;million products per year. As of the end of 2024, PNJ had 429 stores in 58&nbsp;out of 63 provinces and cities. PNJ&#39;s products are exported to 13 foreign countries and territories. The Corporation has its business in&nbsp;mechanical and electrical building services (M&amp;E), manufacturing, equipment and sales of air conditioning systems, development and management of real estate, and investment in&nbsp;strategy and infrastructure sectors. REE takes the first position in the electrical engineering works market with more than 40 years of experience in construction and installation M&amp;E works in infrastructure, commerce, and industries.&nbsp;REE currently manages and operates a real estate leasing business with 144,854 square meters of office space. Additionally, the company owns a total power generation capacity of 2,845 MW and a water supply capacity of over 1.3 million cubic meters per day.&nbsp;REE has been listed on Hochiminh Stock Exchange (HOSE) since 2000.</p>\r\n</div>\r\n<quillbot-extension-portal></quillbot-extension-portal> <div style="FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt;">\r\n<p>C&ocirc;ng ty Cổ phần Cơ Điện Lạnh (REE) c&oacute; tiền th&acirc;n l&agrave;&nbsp;X&iacute; nghiệp Quốc doanh Cơ Điện Lạnh được th&agrave;nh lập v&agrave;o năm&nbsp;1977. REE dẫn&nbsp;đầu&nbsp;trong thị trường cơ điện c&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh với hơn&nbsp;40 năm kinh nghi&ecirc;̣m thi c&ocirc;ng c&ocirc;ng tr&igrave;nh M&amp;E trong c&aacute;c lĩnh vực cơ sở hạ tầng, thương mại v&agrave; c&ocirc;ng nghi&ecirc;̣p. In the real estate business, TCH has implemented many large-scale projects such as Hoang Huy Commerce, Hoang Huy New City, and Hoang Huy Green River, ....    TPB        TPB        16250.0 4.507826e+13              2774046873.0    TPB None    BUY    27-May-25 Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank              TPBank Ngân hàng Thương mại Cổ phần Tiên Phong              TPBank            NH        VNINDEX  Banks Ngân hàng                1.166793e+11                    7158511.0              21715.0             11986.0               0.24524                         0.3               0.0  Nga Ho                 -0.027692                     0.0                 -0.027692       15800.0 <div style="font-family: Arial; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank (TPB)&nbsp;was&nbsp;established in 2008. TPB inherited&nbsp;a solid strength from strategic shareholders, including DOJI Gold &amp; Gems Group, FPT Corporation, Viet Nam National Reinsurance Corporation, SBI Ven Holding Pte. Ltd (Singapore), and International Finance Corporation (under the&nbsp;World Bank) and&nbsp;PYN Elite Fund. TPBank is the first bank in Vietnam to meet Basel III and IFRS 9 simultaneously in 2021. International credit rating agency Moody&#39;s maintains the B1 credit rating, and BCA credit index and improves the credit outlook, from &quot;stable&quot; to &quot;positive&quot; - the highest rating in the Vietnamese banking system.&nbsp;In 2024, compared to the same period, the net interest margin (NIM) stood at 3.51%, reflecting a decrease of 0.42%. The non-performing loan ratio was at 1.52%, decreasing of 0.53%. The coverage ratio for non-performing loans (NPL) was at 81.31%, increasing of 17.6%. The net profit after tax of parent company is valued at VND6.1 trillion, increased 36.03%.    VHC        VHC        61200.0 1.373653e+13               224453159.0    VHC None    BUY    26-Jan-26 Vinh Hoan Corporation     Vinh Hoan Corp. Công ty Cổ phần Vĩnh Hoàn  Thủy sản Vĩnh Hoàn            CT        VNINDEX Food & Beverage Thực phẩm và đồ uống                5.244413e+10                     863992.0              69900.0             47209.0              0.192964                         1.0               0.0 Nguyen Nguyen                  0.169935                  2000.0                  0.202614       71600.0 <div style="FONT-FAMILY: Arial; FONT-SIZE: 10pt;">\r\n<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">Vinh Hoan Corporation (VHC), formerly known&nbsp;as Vinh Hoan&nbsp;Private Enterprise,&nbsp;was&nbsp;established in 1997. In 2007, the company transformed into a Joint Stock Company. The company operates in the field of farming, processing and exporting frozen Tra and Basa fish with the main products of Tra, Basa, Snakehead, Tilapia, and fillets under the Vinh Hoan brand name. VHC has been the leading company in Vietnam pangasius industry since 2010, accounting for about 15% market share of the whole industry. The Company&#39;s products are available in well-known retail chains such as Walmart, Target, Trader Joe, and Kroger, and are distributed by leading US food service companies such as Sysco, Gordon Food Service, and US Foods. VHC is leading in the number of certified farming areas in Vietnam with the farming area certified by Aquaculture Stewardship Council (ASC), Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP), Global Good Agricultural Practice (GlobalGAP), reaching 180 hectares, 135ha, and 155ha.
